story: Slide Rock State Park is located in Oak Creek Canyon in Arizona, United States. It takes its name from a natural water slide formed by the slippery bed of Oak Creek. The park is located on Coconino National Forest land and contains a 43-acre working apple farm.
matters: The park contains the Pendley Homestead Historic District, which is one of the few homesteads still preserved in Oak Creek Canyon. Red rock formations typical of the region also surround the park.
